mutations.name: an unparsable brief is served
kills: isAgentVisible withholds an initiative whose brief could not be parsed
isAgentVisible withholds a visibility value outside the closed set

mutations.name: a brief with no visibility key is served
kills: isAgentVisible withholds a new initiative whose brief has no visibility key

mutations.name: the transitional list overrides an explicit owner-only
kills: isAgentVisible lets an explicit owner-only brief override the transitional list

mutations.name: an unreadable charter lets agent-visible briefs through
kills: agentAccess reads an agent-visible brief under an unreadable charter as withheld

mutations.name: the charter's human-only list is ignored
kills: agentAccess reads an agent-visible brief the charter lists human-only as withheld
agentAccess reads a transitional initiative the charter lists human-only as withheld
